visual_action: A fast-cut montage shows Donald Trump in various settings: at a stadium, at rallies, speaking outdoors, on a stage with American and Texas flags, at a port with a ship, signing a document in the Oval Office, and meeting with men in cowboy hats, one of which he is then shown wearing. A portrait of Ronald Reagan is visible in the background of one scene.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Appears in every scene of the montage.

cast.name: Ronald Reagan
cast.evidence: A painted portrait of him is visible in the background in the Oval Office scene.

on_screen_text.text: ONE YEAR OF ZERO BORDER CROSSINGS
INVESTED IN THE FUTURE USING TRUMP ACCOUNTS

spoken_summary: The audio consists of lyrics from the song "That's the Way (I Like It)" by KC & The Sunshine Band, primarily featuring the line "That's the way, I like it."
audio_music: An upbeat, energetic dance remix of the disco song "That's the Way (I Like It)" by KC & The Sunshine Band plays continuously throughout the video, creating a celebratory and positive tone.
cultural_references: The song 'That's the Way (I Like It)' by KC & The Sunshine Band.
The caption 'This is the way' is a popular phrase from the Star Wars series 'The Mandalorian'.
central_claim: Donald Trump kept his promises as president, delivering on key policy areas like drug prices, border security, energy, and manufacturing.
intended_effect: To reinforce a positive view of Donald Trump's presidency and portray him as an effective leader who achieved his goals.
uncertainty_flags: The meaning of 'TRUMP ACCOUNTS' in the on-screen text 'INVESTED IN THE FUTURE USING TRUMP ACCOUNTS' is unclear.
